compiled_state.description:
## Context

Discovered during ticket c465 (PydanticAIRunner lifecycle revalidation, epic
financial-stoneware-brant). In `PydanticAIRunner.run()` (src/rebar/llm/runner.py), the
finalization/spend-recording tail runs strictly AFTER both:
- the `with ProviderSession(...) as provider_session:` block has exited (runner.py:452-708),
  and
- the failure-accounting `try/except/finally` around the agent call (runner.py:605-707).

Concretely: `log_call_success` (:716) fires, THEN `_findings.finalize_outcome` (:725) runs,
THEN `record_call_spend` (:751). If `finalize_outcome` raises (e.g. schema validation failure
on a structured/verify_completion call), the exception propagates raw out of `run()`:
- `log_call_success` already fired (by design — its docstring explicitly wants this).
- `record_call_spend` NEVER fires — the call already burned real tokens but leaves no spend
  row in usage.jsonl / the billable-CI sink.
- `interpret_failure`/`usage_log.record_failure`/`step_failures.record` are also skipped,
  since they live inside the already-closed except block around the agent call, not around
  finalize_outcome.

This is the mirror case to bug 8455 (a raise DURING the agent call itself, which
`usage_log.record_failure` in the except block now covers) — but 8455's fix does not reach
this later boundary.

A characterization test pinning this CURRENT behavior was added in c465's landed change:
`tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py::test_a_raise_in_finalize_outcome_still_logs_but_skips_the_spend_row`.

## Problem

A structured/verify_completion call that succeeds at the model level but fails schema
validation in `finalize_outcome` silently loses its spend attribution — undercounting real
token spend in cost reporting with no error surfaced for the loss itself (the ValueError/
schema error IS raised to the caller, but nothing signals the missing spend row specifically).

## Approach (not yet designed — this ticket is to decide and implement a fix)

Options to weigh: (a) wrap `finalize_outcome` so a spend row is recorded before propagating its
raise (mirrors bug 8455's discipline for the agent-call except block); (b) move
`record_call_spend` earlier, before `finalize_outcome`, if usage/token counts are already known
at that point (they are — `usage` is populated before `log_call_success`); (c) some other
narrow fix. Whatever is chosen must not duplicate ProviderSession/ExitStack, must not introduce
a generic hook/plugin bus, and must be proven with a RED-before-GREEN test derived from the
characterization test above (which pins CURRENT behavior and must be updated to pin the FIXED
behavior once this bug is resolved).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A raise in `finalize_outcome` still results in a spend row being recorded for tokens
      already consumed by the call.
- [ ] `test_a_raise_in_finalize_outcome_still_logs_but_skips_the_spend_row` (or its replacement)
      is updated to assert the FIXED behavior (spend row present) rather than the gap.
- [ ] No regression to the existing failure-accounting path for a raise during the agent call
      itself (bug 8455's coverage).
compiled_state.title: record_call_spend is skipped when finalize_outcome raises (silent spend-row loss)
